source: StarPup from pupkins.moku.gg (Moku-approved), extracted 2026-10-26: Asset Library/moku/pupkins-hub/starpup/starpup.glb (22,629 tris, 25 bones, PSPS_Idle + PSPS_Run). Over 1.5 MB, so the textures were re-encoded as WebP q90 by node tools/art/webp_glbs.mjs starpup (geometry, skins, clips unchanged; the source textures are already JPEG, so it only goes 1,733,284 -> 1,731,064 bytes: the size is the geometry). Not copied: pup-home/starpup-clips.glb (Sit / Sleep / Chill / Eat / Dig / Cute / Swim, no idle / run / jump) and pup-home/starpup-run.glb (PSPS_Run, same keyframe data as the one inside starpup.glb).
note: Same PSPS clip set as Schiffy but no PSPS_Jump for this pup: jump / fall play the idle clip with the code stretch / squash on top (clipFallback + ProceduralMotion), slide = idle clip + code squash/lean, land = code squash. Never in an enemy roster.
